title: Beautiful Arrangement II
description: Construct an array of n integers from 1 to n such that there are exactly k distinct differences between adjacent elements.
pseudocode:
1: let res = []
2: let left = 1, right = k + 1
3: while left <= right:
4:   if (k % 2 == 1) res.push(left++)
5:   else res.push(right--)
6:   k--
7: for i from k + 2 to n: res.push(i)

steps.note: Set pointers for the oscillating range
k is 3 (odd), add left pointer and increment
k is 2 (even), add right pointer and decrement
k is 1 (odd), add left pointer and increment
k is 0 (even), add right pointer and decrement
